note: Posable (non-'(drv)') pose bones on the Diffeomorphic-imported rig. Drive these via pose.bones[name].rotation_euler using EACH BONE'S OWN rotation_mode (do not force XYZ order -- DAZ's native per-bone axis order matters for multi-axis rotations). rotation_limits_radians, where present, come from a LIMIT_ROTATION constraint already on the bone (imported from DAZ's own joint limits) and are enforced automatically by Blender at evaluation time; null per-axis or null overall means unconstrained -- keep natural-language-driven rotations near documented anatomical ranges anyway to avoid clamped/ugly poses. has_corrective_layer=true bones additionally carry an additive '(drv)' JCM layer (mix_mode=BEFORE_FULL) that combines automatically -- safe to pose directly. rest_head_world/rest_tail_world are this bone's rest-pose head/tail position in world space (armature.matrix_world @ bone.head_local/tail_local) -- the same coordinate system pose.ik_targets, pose.pole_targets, and pose.look_at_target are expressed in. Use these as spatial landmarks (e.g. chest, l_shoulder, r_shoulder) to compute IK/pole target positions for a description with a spatial goal.
